Dr. Mathai’s Dental Clinic on Malad Link Road, near Sai Palace Hotel, has been a life-changing experience for me in dealing with my severe TMJ problem, which I had been struggling with since 2015. In June 2025, the issue became intense again — there were times when I could barely open my mouth, and if I did, closing it was extremely painful. Eating and sleeping became difficult, and it was mentally exhausting.
A referral led me to Dr. Mathai’s clinic, where I met Dr. Paul. From the very first consultation, he took my condition seriously, placed me under careful observation, and confidently assured me that he would help resolve it step by step — provided I followed his guidance properly.
What truly stood out was how proactive Dr. Paul is. He is always ahead when it comes to precautions, advanced technology, and treatment planning. He made me understand the importance of physiotherapy in treating TMJ, something I hadn’t fully realized before. Following his advice, I completed my physio sessions, and today my problem is around 90% resolved.
Beyond his medical expertise, Dr. Paul’s nature is exceptional. He is humble, friendly, patient, and gives proper time to every patient. He personally follows up through calls or WhatsApp to check on recovery, which shows genuine care. His staff is equally supportive and cooperative.
I would highly recommend Dr. Mathai’s Dental Clinic for anyone facing TMJ issues or dental problems. One of my friends had also strongly recommended Dr. Paul after his own major issue was successfully resolved there — and now I completely understand why. If you are looking for expert treatment with personal care, this clinic is an excellent choice.
